scripts.//test: NODE_OPTIONS=--no-experimental-webstorage disables Node 25's default Web Storage API, which installs a stub globalThis.localStorage that shadows jsdom's. The alternative --localstorage-file=PATH would make Node's storage real, but it backs everything with a single SQLite file that persists across test runs and is shared by parallel workers, breaking test isolation, so it is not a substitute for jsdom's per-window storage. CI on Node 24 only knows the long flag form (the short --no-webstorage alias was added in Node 25). See vitest-dev/vitest#8757 and nodejs/node#57658.
